propositions: The box fixture in test_autodeploy_review_drain.py copies full os.environ and returns it as fixture value, causing pytest default traceback rendering to print ambient credentials in failure output.
Pytest renders fixture arguments through 240-character saferepr in long traceback format, exposing plaintext secrets early in the environment mapping.
The fixture must pass only required environment variables (PATH, DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX, HEALTH_TIMEOUT) while preserving bash subprocess environment behavior.
Seven sibling fixture patterns across autodeploy and CLI test files replicate the same dict(os.environ)-inside-rendered-fixture vulnerability.
A deterministic regression test using synthetic sentinel in ambient environment must fail before fix and pass after, proving credential absence from failure output.
Repository gates, type checking, and linting must pass with no production behavior or assertion changes.
